messages:
violet (product): GA announcement: ToolBridge v1 is GA on Hosted API. It combines streaming + tool-calling with per-request policy controls and a compact JSON framing format. Rolling us-west-2 then eu-west-1; full global rollouts over 48h. Migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/toolbridge-ga

sam (eng-runtime): Key API: POST /v2/toolbridge with header X-RW-ToolBridge: 1. Tool usage is opt-in per-project. We added per-request call_timeouts and tool_budget to stop runaway loops. Backwards compat: /v1/toolcall remains but will be deprecated in 90 days.

raj (devex): Quick client examples: 
JS: client.toolbridge.call({model:'nova-7b',tools:['http'],session:'s1'})
Curl: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-ToolBridge: 1" -d '{"model":"nova-7b","session":"s1"}' https://api.redwood.com/v2/toolbridge

iris (eng-sre): Observability: ToolBridge dashboards live in Console. Default alerts: tool-call failure rate > 0.7% for 5m or session error p95 > 600ms for 3m. We'll watch fallback-to-shim metric during rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy complete toolbridge-service@stable at 2650004400 :white_check_mark:

faye (docs): Migration checklist and examples (JS/Python/Go) posted: https://redwood.example.com/docs/toolbridge-migrate. Note: responses include a top-level "bridge_meta" block; parse that first to handle incremental tool outputs. File PRs if you catch missing edge-cases.

noah (customer-success): Coordinating two office hours tomorrow 9am & 3pm PT for high-usage customers and Dedicated migrations. If teams want to join and present tips, DM me.

violet (product): Thanks team  we'll post a short public blurb in #general and schedule a cross-team sync later today for any outstanding migration blockers. :tada:
